lean_consumer_control.interpretation: Excluded local capability diagnostic with common benchmark-module-images support; compiler dependencies remain. Process endpoints are not live heap or peak RSS.

join_pc_profile.interpretation: Unscored user self-PC samples over 100 complete Store lifecycles, including startup/GC and capture overhead; not execution-only/inclusive time, allocation counts or live heap. Inert PC CSVs, owner ranges and exact symbol inventories support offline attribution without exporting ELFs.

historical_failures: Original failed and incomplete native/source-guard attempts remain in the archive and native history. Only explicitly selected passing scopes count toward current acceptance; no fixed prior-batch target count is reused.
interpretation: Local descriptive whole-process results retain actual source/input identities. RSS includes code, runtime, allocator and warmup history and is not live heap, allocation or peak. WASI moves independently. Original pinned Test262 subset, source guards, native scopes, optional consumer control and unscored profiling remain distinct; no full-suite, universal gain or achieved Scriptc parity claim.
